description: Open a URL in the COR-controlled browser. The browser starts on first use and is reused across calls. For a page behind a login, pass a Playwright storage-state file so the existing session is adopted. The reply lists the page's controls with refs (on a large page, a region index) — no cor_snapshot needed first — and, when the project's code already uses COR entries for this page, which members those are and whether each still finds its element.

storageState.description: Path to a Playwright storage-state JSON file ({cookies, origins}) — e.g. from `npx playwright codegen --save-storage`.

name: cor_open
title: Open a page
